definitions.js: const start=root.querySelector('.d-hardware-vinyl-player-card-start'),cue=root.querySelector('[data-cue]'),speed=root.querySelector('.d-hardware-vinyl-player-card-speed'),status=root.querySelector('[role=status]');let playing=false,fast=false;function set(next){playing=next;root.dataset.playing=String(next);start.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(next));start.setAttribute('aria-label',next?'Stop record':'Start record');cue.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(next));cue.textContent=next?'Lift tonearm':'Lower tonearm';status.textContent=next?'Record playing, tonearm lowered':'Turntable stopped, tonearm resting'}start.onclick=cue.onclick=()=>set(!playing);speed.onclick=()=>{fast=!fast;speed.textContent=fast?'45':'33⅓';speed.setAttribute('aria-label','Switch to '+(fast?'33⅓':'45')+' RPM');root.querySelector('.d-hardware-vinyl-player-card-record').style.animationDuration=fast?'1.333s':'1.8s';root.dataset.speed=fast?'45':'33';status.textContent=(fast?'45':'33⅓')+' RPM'};set(false);

.d-hardware-foil-trading-card{height:320px;min-height:320px;width:100%;position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-sizing:border-box;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#eeefed;color:#373b3d;font:400 12px/1.4 Inter,Arial,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.d-hardware-foil-trading-card *{box-sizing:border-box}.d-hardware-foil-trading-card button,.d-hardware-foil-trading-card input{font:inherit}.d-hardware-foil-trading-card button{cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}.d-hardware-foil-trading-card button:focus-visible,.d-hardware-foil-trading-card input:focus-visible,.d-hardware-foil-trading-card [tabindex]:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #5e8097;outline-offset:5px}.d-hardware-foil-trading-card button:disabled{cursor:wait}.d-hardware-foil-trading-card-sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%)}.d-hardware-foil-trading-card-caption{position:absolute;bottom:22px;left:12px;right:12px;text-align:center;color:#727677;font-size:11px}.d-hardware-foil-trading-card-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;position:absolute;bottom:23px;left:15px;right:15px}.d-hardware-foil-trading-card-actions button{border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #b5baba;background:none;color:#535b5f;padding:3px 0;font-size:11px}.d-hardware-foil-trading-card svg{display:block}.d-hardware-foil-trading-card button svg{pointer-events:none}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.d-hardware-foil-trading-card *,.d-hardware-foil-trading-card *:before,.d-hardware-foil-trading-card *:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
